content:
- Choose-Task read progress log, current_tasks.md, current_tasks_done.md, and active task definitions.
- Active backlog has no failing bug tasks and no active priority or explicit blocked_by tags.
- Selected Story 6 Task 3 because Story 6 Tasks 1 and 2 already pass, making startup dependency validation the next logical unblocked failing task before moving to later stories.

- Read previous progress, .ralph/current_task.txt, Story 6 Task 3, required tdd skill, and improve-code-boundaries skill.
- Task 3 had no existing plan and was not already in NOW EXECUTE, so created .ralph/tasks/story-6-config-unification/task-3-startup-validation_plans/startup-dependency-validation-plan.md.
- The plan uses TDD vertical slices and improve-code-boundaries to design shared startup dependency validation instead of duplicated binary probes.
- Plan ends with NOW EXECUTE. Next agent should read the tdd skill again, execute that plan, and only change design back to TO BE VERIFIED if implementation proves the interface/types wrong.

- Started execution turn for Story 6 Task 3.
- Read prior progress and confirmed existing plan should be in NOW EXECUTE state.
- Next: read task/plan and inspect startup/config code before first TDD slice.

- Read task and NOW EXECUTE plan plus improve-code-boundaries smell files.
- Inspected config, DB, search, SyncFeed, API startup, and all three binary CLI surfaces.
- Found config crate cannot own runtime dependency probes directly because opentk-db already depends on opentk-config; adding config -> db/search/sync would create dependency cycles.
- Decision: implement one shared runtime startup validation boundary in opentk-db, using real clients and typed errors, then wire binaries/API to it.

- Added shared opentk-db::startup_validation module with typed dependency status/report/error types and 5s timeout.
- Added MeilisearchClient::validate_reachable using GET /stats.
- Added focused startup_validation integration tests for DB success/failure, Meilisearch required/optional behavior, and SyncFeed base URL success/failure.
- Ran focused test: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 ./scripts/cargo-test-with-postgres.sh -p opentk-db --test startup_validation; 7 passed.
- Next: wire all CLIs and API startup to shared validation, then run checks.

- Wired --validate-config for opentk-api, opentk-sync, and search-sync; API also supports --validate-config --require-search and rejects --require-search alone.
- Updated API startup to run DB startup validation and use Meilisearch /stats validation for optional degraded search instead of fake search queries.
- Verification completed: make check passed, make lint passed, make test passed. Did not run make test-long per task instruction.
- Next: final boundary scan, mark task/plan complete, run task_switch, commit all files, push.
